classification.difficultyReason: Each diagram already supplies three region counts; fill its single blank by subtracting from a relevant set total or the overall total.

content.prompt: Finish these Venn diagrams with the given information.

children.label: a
children.prompt: 15 students are asked whether they use Tiktok and Spotify. 7 use TikTok, 10 use Spotify and 2 students don’t use either.

spec.description: Unshaded universal-set frame with overlapping TikTok and Spotify circles. The neither-region response box is replaced by a dotted completion line.
spec.mathematics: TikTok only 3; both 4; Spotify only 6; neither missing.
spec.answerVisibility: The missing neither-region value is absent from the question diagram.

spec.description: Completed unshaded TikTok and Spotify Venn diagram.
spec.answerVisibility: All four region values are visible in the solution.

children.label: b
children.prompt: 30 athletes are asked whether they run or go to the gym as part of their training. 27 run, 25 go to the gym and 1 person, who is injured, says that they do neither.

spec.description: Unshaded universal-set frame with Run left and Gym right. The intersection response box is replaced by a dotted completion line.
spec.mathematics: Run only 3; both missing; Gym only 1; neither 1.
spec.answerVisibility: The intersection value is absent from the question diagram.

answer.worked: Both $=27-3=24$. Check: $24+1=25$ go to the gym, and $3+24+1+1=30$ athletes.

spec.description: Completed unshaded Run and Gym Venn diagram.
spec.answerVisibility: All four region values are visible in the solution.

children.label: c
children.prompt: 28 people are asked whether they are confident at spelling and grammar. 12 confident at both, 5 aren’t confident with either and 19 confident at grammar.

spec.description: Unshaded universal-set frame with Spelling left and Grammar right. The spelling-only response box is replaced by a dotted completion line.
spec.mathematics: Spelling only missing; both 12; Grammar only 7; neither 5.
spec.answerVisibility: The spelling-only value is absent from the question diagram.

spec.description: Completed unshaded Spelling and Grammar Venn diagram.
spec.answerVisibility: All four region values are visible in the solution.

children.prompt: 50 visitors are surveyed on their way out from a waterpark. 23 people went on The Claw, 30 people went on the Taipan and 11 people did not go on either.

spec.mathematics: The Claw only 9; both 14; Steel Taipan only missing; neither 11.
spec.answerVisibility: The Taipan-only value is absent from the question diagram.
